maria-peopleops: Quick heads-up — looks like employer HSA contributions for Q1 didn’t hit for ~12 people. Vendor flagged those employees as "inactive" in the payroll export for the 01/15 and 02/15 runs. Can payroll + benefits confirm next steps and timeline?

jamal-payroll: I noticed the status field in the export was set to `terminated` for those employee IDs. I can pull the full export and affected list. Want me to attach CSV? :thinking_face:

sophia-benefits: Yes please attach CSV. Also need to confirm whether we can do an off-cycle employer contribution or if it has to be corrected via next regular contribution. Concerned about HSA plan and tax reporting if delayed.

maria-peopleops: Attaching a scrubbed sample from the export below (IDs + amounts). Small amounts but still need to be fixed.

maria-peopleops: ```
emp_id,emp_email,status,hsa_employer_contrib,date
84921,dev1@redwood.com,terminated,200.00,2025-01-15
85002,pm2@redwood.com,terminated,150.00,2025-01-15
85333,eng3@redwood.com,terminated,180.00,2025-02-15
```

ben-vendor: Hey all, Ben from the payroll vendor here. We discovered an import rule that incorrectly mapped active contractors to "terminated" when the job_type field was empty. We can run an off-cycle adjustment for employer HSA contributions. Need: 1) official authorization from plan admin, 2) final affected employee list + contribution amounts, and 3) funding confirmation from finance. ETA for processing once we have those is 7 business days.

alex-finance: Thanks Ben. Finance needs the total dollar amount to schedule the transfer and GL code. Use GL: 6002-BEN-HSA-Q1 (Benefits: HSA Employer Contributions Q1). Please confirm total and whether we need to do an intercompany charge.

jamal-payroll: I'll pull the full list and amounts by EOD and attach the sanitized file. Also can we get confirmation on whether this creates any W-2 or Form 8889 implications?

sophia-benefits: Off-cycle employer contributions remain employer HSA deposits and are reportable in the year contributed. They shouldn't change employee pre-tax deferrals, but we should confirm with the plan admin that retro deposits are allowed. I'll ping our TPA and confirm the plan document.

payroll-bot: Ticket PV-48231 created with vendor (https://vendor.example.com/tickets/PV-48231). Vendor ETA: processing window Mar 4 - Mar 11. Updates will post here. :gear:

maria-peopleops: Great — I'll collect the signed authorization + sanitized list and @alex-finance will confirm funding. Thanks everyone, please drop any blockers.

alex-finance: FYI — if the total > $10k we need VP approval for a one-off cash movement. If it looks close, tag me and I'll brief Leah.

ben-vendor: Noted. Once we have the signed doc we’ll queue the off-cycle job and confirm with a follow-up message that posting completed.

sophia-benefits: I'll follow up with the TPA about plan language and tax treatment and post back here.

maria-peopleops: Thanks :pray: I’ll upload the list + signed form shortly.
